spans.s:
m. (-षः)
1 Fault, defect, blemish.
2 Sin, offence, transgression.
3 Disorder of the humours of the body, or defect in the functions of bile, circulation, or wind.
4 A calf.
E.
दुष to be defective, affix घञ्.

Night.
2

The arm.
ind. (-षा)
1 By night, at night.
2 At the beginning of the night.
E.
दम to tame, डोस् affix, and टाप् added.

m. (-कः)
A calf.
E.
कन् added to दोष.

n. (-नं)
Reprehending, condemning.
E.
दोष, and कल्पन attributing.

mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि)
Malicious, malignant, censorious.
E.
दोष a fault, ग्रह to take, affix णिनि.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Knowing faults, &c.
m. (-ज्ञः)
1 A Paṇḍita, a teacher, a sage.
2 A physician.
E.
दोष fault, defect, and ज्ञ who knows.

n. (-यं)
1 Vitiation of the three humours, bile, wind, and phlegm.
2 Any combination of three defects.
E.
दोष, and त्रय triad.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Censure, condemnation.
E.
दोष, and प्रसङ्ग attribution.

mfn. (-भाक्)
Wrong, faulty, doing wrong, being defective or to blame.
E.
दोष, and भाज् who or what shares.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Faulty, defective.
2 Wicked.
E.
दोष, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Defective, faulty.
m. (-रः)
The moon.
E.
दोषा night, and कर a ray; or दोष, and आकर a mine.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Nocturnal, by night.
E.
दोषा by night, द्यु aff.

m. (-कः)
A lamp.
E.
दोषा night, and तिलक excellence.

m. (-स्यः)
A lamp.
E.
दोषा night, and आस्य a face.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Faulty, defective, bad.
m. (कः)
Sickness, disease.
E.
दोष defect, ठक् aff.

mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि)
1 Faulty, defective.
2 Wicked, bad.
E.
टुष to be defective, affix घिनुण्.

mfn. (-दृक्)
Malevolent, censorious, discovering defects only.
E.
दोष a fault, एक one, alone, and दृश् seeing.

m. (-दोः)
1 The arm.
2 The side of a triangle, or square, &c.
E.
दम to subdue, affix डोम्.

mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं)
Worn, &c. on the arms.
E.
दोस् the arm, क aff.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Placed on the arm.
m. (-स्थः)
1 Play, sport.
2 A player, one who sports or plays.
3

Service.
4

A servant.
E.
दु bad, स्था to stay, ड affix दुस्थ, अण् added.
